remaining_findings.title: Validate the persisted named child contract before filtering receipt children
remaining_findings.consequence: The named receipt key pins decision_id, operation, sorted parent IDs and basis, but does not pin the typed child contract. The replay branch filters existing children by current kind and scope before deciding whether prior children exist. Reusing a one-child merge receipt for a term-to-rule change filters away the persisted child and silently allocates a replacement under the same named receipt, with no contract conflict. Persisted lineage decision provenance becomes inconsistent.
remaining_findings.reproducer: Merge North/South terms into one Together term using decision_id merge-child-contract. Reuse its decision ID, operation, parent IDs and basis with the child locator changed from /terms/0 to /rules/0, supplying a rule child R-Together. The current result assigns the new rule child instead of rejecting or leaving an explicit unresolved contract conflict.

This is an identity/provenance boundary independent of publisher meaning.
